title: Figure-8 knot $4_1$ as illustration of the algebraic / archimedean dichotomy
html:
Remark. Figure-8 knot 4_1 as illustration of the algebraic / archimedean dichotomy

Remark (figure-8 knot as the canonical algebraic / archimedean example).

The figure-8 knot 4_1 is the smallest hyperbolic knot [thurston1978] and serves as the cleanest illustration of the dual existence forced by prop:archimedean-functor-uniqueness: algebraic / motivic in the substrate, transcendental in the laboratory.

Embedding in Bring's surface. The figure-8 knot embeds smoothly into Bring's surface (genus 4) as the amphichiral mass mechanism. Its braid word \sigma_1\sigma_2^{-1}\sigma_1\sigma_2^{-1} realises on 4 strands and the braid closure reproduces 4_1 inside the genus-4 handlebody. The amphichirality 4_1 \cong 4_1^{\,\text{mirror}} — equivalently, invariance under the bar involution q \mapsto q^{-1} — is what selects the figure-8 as a mass invariant rather than a chirality invariant.

Pre-archimedean (substrate) representation. On the algebraic side, 4_1 has a rigorous motivic representation via its Hecke normal form. The algebraic quantum volume of 4_1 is a finite product of Laurent polynomials,

  \mathrm{Vol}_q(4_1)
  \;=\;
  \prod_{i=0}^{2} \hat{V}_i(q)
  \;\in\;
  \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}],

with the \hat{V}_i(q) explicitly determined by the four-strand braid word above (cf. thm:markov-trace-factorization). At this level no \pi, no \zeta-values, no real-analytic transcendentals appear: the entire object is a Laurent polynomial in q^{\pm 1/2} and lives strictly in the substrate ring R.

Archimedean (laboratory) image. Apply the archimedean realization functor \tau_{\text{arch}} = \pi_\infty \circ \tau (archimedean realization functor). The image of \mathrm{Vol}_q(4_1) under \tau_{\text{arch}} in the Faddeev-Kashaev quasi-classical limit is the hyperbolic volume of the figure-8 knot complement S^3 \setminus 4_1 (Kashaev volume conjecture), which evaluates as the transcendental

  \boxed{\;
    \mathrm{Vol}(4_1)
    \;=\;
    2\,D(\mathrm{e}^{i\pi/3})
    \;=\;
    2\,\mathrm{Cl}_2\!\left(\tfrac{\pi}{3}\right)
    \;\approx\;
    2.02988\ldots
  \;}

where D is the Bloch-Wigner dilogarithm and \mathrm{Cl}_2 is the Clausen function. The transcendence of \mathrm{Cl}_2(\pi/3) is conjectural in number theory but the form of the answer is forced by Bloch-Suslin pentagon-uniqueness: any archimedean realization of the substrate's pentagon-coherent class must factor through D, and the figure-8's three ideal-tetrahedron triangulation pins down the specific shape parameter z = e^{i\pi/3}.

The dichotomy in one line. The motivic side guarantees exact, q-rational algebraic relationships governing particle interactions; \tau_{\text{arch}} supplies the transcendental continuum required for geometric measurement. Both pictures are needed:

Side Object for 4_1 Lives in Role
Pre-archimedean \mathrm{Vol}_q(4_1) = \prod_i \hat{V}_i(q) \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}] Exact algebraic identities, mass-formula state sum, Hecke trace
Archimedean \mathrm{Vol}(4_1) = 2\,\mathrm{Cl}_2(\pi/3) \mathbb{R} (transcendental) Laboratory mass-scale, Higgs-like amphichiral mechanism

The bridge between the two columns is uniquely determined by prop:archimedean-functor-uniqueness: no other archimedean image is admissible.

Cross-reference: \alpha_{EM}. The same dichotomy underlies the additive Bring zero-mode candidate prop:em-coupling-bring-zero-mode: the \pi in 4_1's archimedean image 2\,\mathrm{Cl}_2(\pi/3) and the \pi in 1/\alpha_{EM}'s correction 2/(3\pi) = 2g/(4\pi(g-1)) at g=4 share a single provenance — the unique archimedean shadow of pentagon-coherent substrate data on Bring's surface, factored through the Bloch-Wigner dilogarithm. The exact algebraic values 2.02988\ldots = 2\,\mathrm{Cl}_2(\pi/3) matches the standard hyperbolic 2-tetrahedra triangulation [thurston1978].
